_comment: Operational settings the workflows read. Changing the model or the batch sizes is a config edit plus `npm run build` - no node editing in n8n.

llm._model_note: Verified against the live API on 2026-08-29 with scripts/check-gemini-models.mjs. Google rotates model IDs and free-tier quotas - re-check if reports start falling back.
llm._token_note: Gemini bills internal reasoning against maxOutputTokens. Measured on this prompt with thinking on: 1148 thinking tokens of a 1200 budget, 37 left for the answer, response truncated. With thinking off the report needs ~570. Re-measure with scripts/test-llm-call.mjs after changing the prompt or the model.

cache._comment: How long a stored report may be reused. Short enough that an afternoon /report reflects a newer model run; long enough to keep the free tier comfortable.

broadcast._comment: generation_* paces report generation against the LLM free tier (~10-15 requests/minute). send_* paces Telegram delivery, which allows roughly 30 messages/second globally but is far happier below that.

ensemble._comment: Several independent models are queried and combined conservatively, because measured disagreement between them is wider than the rating boundaries it feeds: 0.33 m mean on wave height against a 0.50 m CAUTION band, and 10.9 kt mean on peak gust against a 5 kt band (scripts/model-spread.mjs, scripts/wind-spread.mjs, 2026-08-29).
ensemble._marine_note: All four are credible for the western Mediterranean. mfwam is rejected by the API and meteofrance_wave is the same product under its supported name.
ensemble._atmospheric_note: Deliberately excludes gfs_seamless, which averaged 12.1 kt where the others averaged 20-22 kt across the same six sites - at ~25 km resolution it cannot resolve this coastline, so it is an outlier rather than a peer. Also excludes icon_seamless, which returned values identical to icon_eu: counting the same model twice would manufacture false agreement.

api._marine_split_note: The pinned wave models carry sea state only - no sea-surface temperature and no currents. Requesting them alongside the wave variables returns nulls, which capped swimming at CAUTION every day for a self-inflicted missing-data reason. They therefore come from a second, unpinned request and are merged by timestamp.
